summary: This Cooperation Agreement (JSXCS1200166CC000) establishes a mobile game service partnership between Dazzle Interactive Network Technologies Co., Ltd. (Party A, based in Nanjing, CN) and Shenzhen iDreamSky Technology Co., Ltd. (Party B, based in Shenzhen, CN). Party B supplies mobile games and related technical support, while Party A provides network, portal, advertising resources and billing services, sharing information fees as stipulated. The contract is effective 1 January 2013, runs for one year with a single automatic renewal, includes performance‑bond requirements, detailed billing/sharing formulas, and extensive rights, obligations, and termination provisions.

clauses.summary: Scope of cooperation – Party B supplies games (own or authorized) and technical support; Party A supplies network, portal, advertising, and billing services, sharing information fees.
Party A’s rights to pre‑emptively use the cooperation nationwide, to review Party B’s licences, content legality, and to amend business standards; Party A may terminate if standards are not met.
Party B must hold valid licences, ensure IP ownership or proper authorisation, and guarantee that its content does not infringe any third‑party rights.

Performance bond: RMB 3,000 payable on effectiveness; additional bonds of RMB 5,000‑10,000 per violation; up to RMB 50,000 may be withheld per dispute; bond returned within 30 days after 2‑year post‑termination period if no disputes.

Billing & settlement: Party B’s information‑fee price approved by Party A; revenue sharing – 70 % of net revenue to Party B for content cooperation, 40 % for channel cooperation; monthly settlement with first payment due end of third month.
Confidentiality: Both parties must keep all exchanged information confidential, may not disclose the agreement or any proprietary data without written consent, except as required by law.

Liabilities for breach: Penalties up to 100 % of receivable fees or RMB 3,000, right to suspend interface, withhold settlement, and claim damages; detailed breach list (illegal content, excessive complaints, IP infringement, etc.).
Effectiveness, term & renewal: Effective 1 Jan 2013, term of 1 year; automatically renews for one additional year unless objection is raised; amendment requires 30‑day notice.
Integrity (anti‑bribery) agreement: Both parties and their staff must not give or receive off‑the‑book rebates, gifts, or other improper benefits; violations allow suspension and compensation claims.
Dispute resolution: Attempts at amicable negotiation first; failing that, disputes submitted to the competent court where Party A is domiciled.
